voidsession_register_shutdown
Registers session_write_close as a shutdown function.
The shutdown functions run in the order of registration. A function registered with register_shutdown_function before this call still has an active session and its changes to $_SESSION are written. A function registered after it runs once the session is closed: session_status returns PHP_SESSION_NONE and its changes to $_SESSION are not saved.
Each call registers the shutdown function again. Only the first one writes the session; the following ones do nothing, as the session is already closed.
session_set_save_handler calls this function by default, unless its register_shutdown parameter is &false;.
